product.description: Pomegranates have a red or pinkish-yellow skin on the outside and inside there are hundreds of seeds surrounded by a cream-coloured membrane. Remove that membrane and enjoy the sweet-tart flavour of the bright red seeds. The seeds (or arils) taste great in salad, yogurt, and on their own as a snack.

Blueberries range in colour from a deep purple-blue to a blue-black, both with a silvery sheen called bloom. Sweeten your morning by sprinkling blueberries on your cereal or pancakes, or add blueberries to a spinach salad with pecans and blue cheese.

Mini cucumbers are small versions of the English variety with a bit more crunch. Mini cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and can eaten with the skin on. Take them with you as a snack on the go or add diced mini cucumbers to your next vegetable platter or salad.

An excellent source of iron, these delicious Organics Apple and Strawberry Cereal Puffs are a convenient snack that helps encourage self-feeding. With a dissolvable texture, they're easy to chew and swallow. The packaging is resealable to maintain freshness. For 12+ months.

Plant-powered and flavour-loaded with that tantalizing tang you just can’t put down. Light and airy with a satisfying crunch that melts in your mouth. This is snacking done right.


Organics Plant-Based Sour Cream and Onion Flavour Baked Corn Ring Puffs deliver a crispy, tangy, and savoury taste in every light, airy bite. Organic, these corn ring puffs offer that classic sour cream and onion flavour with a satisfying crunch that melts in your mouth. Vegan and gluten-free, they’re an easy choice for lunchboxes, casual snacking, or sharing with friends.

product.description: Atlantic salmon, both farmed and wild, has pink flesh with a high fat ratio. Fresh salmon is available whole or as steaks and fillets and can be cooked in a variety of ways including poaching, roasting, or grilling.
product.productName: Fresh Atlantic Salmon Fillets, Skin On, Packaged

product.description: Greenhouse tomatoes are firm and plump with a red skin when ripe. They are perfect sliced and used as a topping on burgers and sandwiches like the classic BLT. Or scoop out the pulp and seeds to make baked stuffed tomatoes.

Cilantro is the bunched leafy green from the coriander plant. Both the leaves and stems can be used raw or cooked in a variety of dishes. Cilantro works especially well with spicy food. Try it with curry chicken or add some to salsa with a little lime.

Raspberries are delicate fruit with bright red drupelets that connect to each other around a hollow central core. Their flavour is sweet but can also be tart if they aren’t quite ripe. Add them to your morning cereal, smoothie, or yogurt, or indulge with raspberries topped with cream and chocolate shavings.

This organic kombucha combines the sweet, tropical flavour of mango with the bright taste of passionfruit. A lively fizz and balanced sweetness create a refreshing beverage for any time of day. Enjoy it chilled on its own or as a unique complement to a meal.

WELCOMING BACK CRISPERS Chili Lime! Inspired by Mexican cuisine seasoning that is a mix of chili powder, lime and salt! CRISPERS Chili Lime has intense flavour and a satisfying crunch! They’re baked, not fried, making CRISPERS a great snack alternative for any occasion. Meet your snacking soulmate! CRISPERS will put your taste buds on overload, with bold flavours and a crunch that sounds just as good as it tastes. Ready to crush your snack goals? CRISPERS has your back with bold, crunchy, super tasty crackers. Prepare to snack on another level. Whether it’s a picnic in the park or between-meals snack, we've got your A-list snacks! Even better, keep the crunch legit with our resealable bag!

product.description: Lemons have a bright yellow peel and can vary in size depending on the variety. This citrus fruit produces a tart, acidic juice that will add flavour to your salad dressings, beverages, and marinades. Lemon juice and rinds are also versatile ingredients for baking everything from cookies and cakes to a classic lemon meringue pie.
